rationale: The agent verified identity properly using full name and zip, matched to a single account, and only acted on that user’s orders. It retrieved the correct tablet tracking number from tools and correctly declined refund/reorder for a lost-after-delivery item per policy. For each order-changing action, the agent sought explicit confirmation before proceeding: it confirmed and then canceled the pending charger order; identified the order containing the boots and requested confirmation to cancel that order; and confirmed and processed a return for only the sneakers item. All actions taken were supported by tool outputs, and refund routing to the gift card was consistent with payment history. One weakness: when canceling the boots order, the agent did not clearly warn that canceling the order would also cancel the kettle, despite the user’s earlier preference to keep it if possible. However, the agent did explicitly ask to cancel the entire order (#W5481803), and the user explicitly agreed before the write. Final confirmations and outcomes communicated were accurate. Overall, the interaction meets the stated policy requirements.
